description: Behavior of backend/align.py before scoped-overlap-v1, captured on synthetic inputs. These are code-inspection results, not human listening and not acoustic accuracy.
execution: python3 backend/align.py on /tmp/diarization-baseline before any policy edit. Raw JSON hashes are machine-specific because they embed absolute paths; the normalized behavior below is the snapshot.
policy_observations: Alignment read exclusive_turns only and ignored overlap_aware_turns.
Equal exclusive overlap was awarded to the first turn, SPEAKER_00.
A zero-length token contained by two turns was awarded to the first turn.
A token in a gap within 1.5 s of two speakers was awarded to the nearer one.
A token with no offsets was placed at 0 ms and inherited the speaker active there.
Punctuation inside the next speaker was overwritten with the previous speaker.
A token starting at or after --through was omitted from the word count.
A reversed token was treated as a point at its start and assigned.
Status remained review_preview for unassigned speech and for these failures.
Speaker ids were raw model labels with no recording or revision scope.
